parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $\frac{(\tan\theta+1)(1-\cos\theta)+(\tan\theta-1)(1+\cos\theta)}{(1+\cos\theta)(1-\cos\theta)}$ soi. — M1. $\frac{\tan\theta-\tan\theta\cos\theta+1-\cos\theta+\tan\theta-1+\tan\theta\cos\theta-\cos\theta}{1-\cos^2\theta}$ www. — A1. $\frac{2(\tan\theta-\cos\theta)}{\sin^2\theta}$ www AG. — A1. Total 3.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $2(\tan\theta-\cos\theta)=0\to2\left(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}-\cos\theta\right)=0$ soi. — M1. Guidance: Equate numerator to zero and replace $\tan\theta$ by $\sin\theta/\cos\theta$. $2(\sin\theta-(1-\sin^2\theta))=0$. — DM1. Guidance: Multiply by $\cos\theta$ and replace $\cos^2\theta$ by $1-\sin^2\theta$. $\sin\theta=0.618(0)$ soi. — A1. Guidance: Allow $(\sqrt5-1)/2$. $\theta=38.2^\circ$. — A1. Guidance: Apply penalty $-1$ for extra solutions in range. Total 4.
